limitations: Only three-letter words and radius two with alphabet size at least three; the lower bound, endpoint-inequality radius-one code, and binary radius-two exception are prior work. Historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_integrity: Symbolic proof for every integer alphabet size at least three; Python and C++ finite checks are corroborative, not a substitute for the proof.
title: Sharp radius-two identifying codes in length-three directed de Bruijn graphs over nonbinary alphabets
